author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Demo Launch Trailer for Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator, a pet shop sim developed by Onivo Games. Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell a variety of pets, design and decorate your store, serve customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate destination for pet lovers. Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo launching on September 25 on Steam.
title: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the latest trailer for Nightmare Circus, an action-adventure game where you take control of a puppeteer trapped in a mysterious nightmare world filled with fast-paced combat, exploration, puzzles, platforming, and a unique physics-driven combat system.
Nightmare Circus is coming to PC (Steam) in 2027, with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Nightmare Circus - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the Wuthering Waves Version 3.7: Prism’s Illusion, Heart’s Illumination trailer for this next update for the open-world action RPG. The Version 3.7 update continues the main story with Chapter IV Act IV: Simulacrum of the Heart, introduces new Resonators Hsin and Suoming, and opens the new Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou area. Version 3.7 will also bring new Echoes, events, and extensive gameplay optimisations, along with the Wuwa Tappo desktop pet software, new merchandise, and the Solaris Starry Stage fan creation programme.

Wuthering Waves is available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Wuthering Waves - Official Version 3.7 Prism’s Illusion, Heart’s Illumination Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the trailer for Hellheart Breaker, an action dating sim developed by Cusineer. Set in an Asian-inspired Underworld filled with smoke and neon, you awaken in a forgotten room within a bathhouse, soon becoming a new resident of Aashraya, the last remaining city in the Underworld. With no memory of who you are, you embark on a journey to uncover your true identity. Hellheart Breaker will be available in 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Hellheart Breaker - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Legacy Code, a quirky physics sim developed by Room 127. Turn objects into miraculous, mechanized critters called “Mechanimals” by adding limbs. Attach arms and legs to doll heads, motors, dentures, cacti, and much more. Set each Mechanimal loose upon the world to battle other crazy creatures, then affix the leftover limbs from every skirmish before heading back into the fray with an even more capable creature. Legacy Code will be available on PC (Steam) in 2027.
title: Legacy Code - Official Announcement Trailer
